name: Photo Gallery : Spatial Anchor Photo
summary:
Turn your room into a personal photo gallery. Hang your photos on your real walls in mixed reality and arrange them using only your hands.

UPLOAD FROM ANY PHONE OR PC
Open the address shown in the headset menu in a browser on the same Wi-Fi and drop in your photos. They appear in front of you instantly. No app or account needed, and photos stay on your local network and headset.
